name: How do I budget for appliances, fixtures, and finishes in a whole-home remodel?

mainEntity.name: How much should I budget for appliances, fixtures, and finish selections in a whole-home renovation?
mainEntity.text: How much should I budget for appliances, fixtures, and finish selections in a whole-home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Finish choices often create the biggest budget swing after the base construction work. Cabinets, countertops, tile, lighting, plumbing fixtures, and appliances can range from modest to luxury pricing, and allowance amounts in bids may not reflect the quality you expect. The safest approach is to decide your target finish level early, then have your contractor price allowances that match it. That way you can see whether the project budget is realistic before construction starts. If allowances are too low, the project can look affordable on paper but become expensive during selections. Ask which items are fixed-price and which are allowance-based so you can control the final total more accurately.
acceptedAnswer.description: Appliances, fixtures, and finishes can change the budget dramatically because allowances vary widely. If you want mid-range results, set realistic separate budgets for cabinetry, tile, lighting, plumbing fixtures, and appliances instead of assuming they are included at premium quality.
